# Forest Treasure Maps: Rewards Datamining & All Locations

![Forest Treasure Maps: Rewards Datamining & All Locations](/uploads/506_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![MonaLisa](/public/avatar_MonaLisa_ml1080.png) 

Treasure maps show **locations** with buried supplies in the game. To find the location, the **treasure map** must be in your inventory. The more treasure cards you have in your inventory for a location, the more can be dug up at the same time.

Treasure maps have **no carrying weight** and can therefore be stored in large quantities in the inventory. Supplies that can be unearthed include: **Weapons, Armor, Mods, Blueprints, Scrap, Chems, Food.**

In addition to the treasure maps and locations, there is also **data mining** with the possible rewards per area, as well as general rewards and rewards for teammates.

### Index

## Forest treasure maps

### Forest Treasure Map 01

The mound with the treasure is under the Point Pleasant Bridge.

### Forest Treasure Map 02

From the Camp Adams fast travel, head southwest to a small campsite. Under the cooking area is the hill with the treasure.

### Forest Treasure Map 03

From the HG-B7-09 transmission tower you go towards the Werkstadt to a playground. Under the climbing frame is the hill with the treasure.

### Forest treasure map 04

We're going to Anchor Farm. There is an airplane in the garden. To the left of the plane is the hill.

### Forest treasure map 05

Starting from the Charleston depot fast travel point, turn left down to the dry riverbed. Look there for an overturned train carriage. In front of the door is the hill with the treasure.

### Forest treasure map 06

The mound with the treasure can be found in Wayward on the river bank. The illustration on the treasure map corresponds to the area before Wayward was developed.

### Forest treasure map 07

We go to the raider camp Widow's Perch. There is a large billboard in front of the camp. To the right (view from the front) is the hill with the treasure.

### Forest Treasure Map 08

From the Gauley exit mine go to where the railway line crosses the river. The hill is on the south side of the river.

### Forest Treasure Map 09

This treasure can be found in Summerville. From the fast travel point you go through the entire city to the street with the yellow bus.

Next to the first house in a large pile of leaves is the mound with the treasure.

### Forest treasure map 10

From Greg's Mine Supply, head south down to where the river ends. On a ledge is the mound with the treasure.
